description: This file contains functions and types related to OAuth secret reference policy validation within authentication profiles, including violation collection and assertion functions.

methods.name: pushViolation
methods.description: Adds a violation record to the violations array.

methods.name: hasSecretRefInput
methods.description: Checks if a secret reference input exists based on provided parameters.

methods.name: collectTypeOAuthSecretRefViolations
methods.description: Collects violations related to secret references in OAuth profiles.

methods.name: collectOAuthModeSecretRefViolations
methods.description: Collects violations based on the OAuth mode and secret references.

methods.name: collectOAuthSecretRefPolicyViolations
methods.description: Aggregates all OAuth secret reference policy violations for given profiles.

methods.name: assertNoOAuthSecretRefPolicyViolations
methods.description: Throws an error if any OAuth secret reference policy violations are found.
